record.question: Research has shown that the new drug has pernicious effect on the health of patients
record.explanation: Answer A: beneficial. The task asks for an antonym. Pernicious means seriously harmful; “beneficial” reverses that meaning. Detrimental, destructive and baneful all indicate harm. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/pernicious. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
record.direction: Directions (Question Nos. 56-70): Choose the correct antonyms of the underlined words:
record.questionMarkup: Research has shown that the new drug has <u>pernicious</u> effect on the health of patients
